sourceText:
Tian of Vegetables
By: Giangi Townsend
Published: Monday, February 25, 2019 - 4:08pm

Ingredients




2 zucchinis, sliced in small rounds
1 squash, sliced in small rounds
fresh thyme
olive oil
salt and pepper
18 ounces cherry tomaotes
1 tablespoon unsalted butter

Preparation

1 In a heavy cast enamel oval gratin dish, smear the butter all over the bottom and sides. 2 Arrange the slices of zucchini and squash, alternating them. Leave some open space in the middle. Place the cut tomatoes in the middle of the dish. 3 Preheat oven at 350F. 4 In a small skillet with 1 teaspoon of olive oil, sauté the onion over medium heat until translucent. Add some fresh thyme while cooking and season with salt and pepper. 5 When done, 5 to 8 minutes, gently sprinkle them over the zucchini, squash and tomatoes. 6 Season with salt and pepper, fresh thyme and a generous amount of olive oil. 7 Place in the preheated oven and cook for 15 to 20 minutes. 8 Serve hot or at room temperature.

About

Vegetables are so much a part of our life that we always have a dish, if not two nightly.
This is a very simple and yet full of flavor, favorite French dish. This is how I present it or the vegetables that I prefer. However,  you can add thinly sliced potatoes, eggplant as well.
Great side dish to all meats, fish and poultry.
